item.title: Atlanta Black Restaurant Week 2026
item.description:
Sunday, August 2, 2026 at 12 AM

Location: GA

« All Events Dining in the District August 6 @ 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM Dining in the District with Council Member Wayne MartinJoin City Council Member Wayne Martin for Dining in the District, a special community gathering celebrating Black Restaurant Week at Oreatha’s At The Point. This event is an opportunity to connect with neighbors, support local businesses, and experience one of the district’s premier Black-owned restaurants. As we celebrate Black Restaurant Week, we’re highlighting the entrepreneurs and culinary talent that help strengthen our community and local economy. Guests will enjoy Oreatha’s At The Point’s signature menu of comfort fare with international influences, where Southern hospitality meets bold global flavors in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Whether you’re a longtime resident, a first-time visitor, or simply looking to support local businesses, this evening offers the perfect chance to enjoy great food, meaningful conversation, and community fellowship. Come dine, connect, and celebrate Black Restaurant Week while supporting the businesses that make our district thrive. We look forward to seeing you there!
